text:
Alice: Heads-up: planning a deploy tonight during the small change window (23:30 UTC). Touches api, runtime, console, router. Need pins, canary plan, and explicit rollback criteria. Release notes: https://redwood.prod/releases/2026/rel-2.3.1

Deploy-bot: @Alice scheduled deploy queued for 2026-03-23T23:30Z. Runbook stub available. Preflight will run automatically.

Ben: Router team note — can we pin router to a canary variant for the first 10%? Prefer `canary-3`. Also request header-split freeze for the window.

Carla: Runtime smoke passed on staging. Proposal: 10% canary for 30m observation. Success criteria: p95 < 300ms and error rate < 0.5%. If green, ramp to 100% in 15m increments.

Erin: Console telemetry dashboard ready: https://console.redwood/dashboard/rel-2.3.1 — I'll watch token-level latencies and error traces. I'll add alert annotations.

Deploy-bot: preflight checks: api-schema-ok, kv-compat-ok, canary-capacity-sufficient. All checks passed. No blocking migrations detected.

Darren: Quick rollback criteria (consensus): 1) p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m; 2) sustained 5xx rate > 1% for 5m; 3) >= 2 failing critical evals or user-facing regression. If any triggered, rollback immediately and open an incident.

Alice: Sounds good. Also define router pin-unwind plan: if canary fails, pin back to v2.3.0 and drain routes from the new variant. Carla — can you own the rollback command?

Carla: I can. Rollback command (one-liner for on-call):
```
/deploy rollback --service router --from v2.3.1 --to v2.3.0 --reason "canary-latency"
```
I'll also run: `/pin unset console v2.3.1` to avoid stray routes.

Ben: We'll also throttle via router header sampling to limit blast radius. Plan: header `X-Release-Test: canary` -> 10% for first 15m, then 30% for next 15m if green.

Erin: I'll pin an explanatory NOTE on the dashboard with alert thresholds and a link to this thread. :white_check_mark:

Alice: Final plan recap: 23:30 start -> 10% via header-sample -> 30m watch across api/runtime/console -> ramp to 100% if green -> announce in #release-notes. On rollback, run Carla's command and open incident in #incidents. Any last objections?

Ben: No objections from router side. :thumbsup:

Deploy-bot: deploy started at 2026-03-23T23:30Z. Canary 10% routed. Variants: router=canary-3, runtime=q2-profile, api=v2.3.1. Monitoring hooks enabled.

Carla: Canary logs are stable so far, p95 ~210ms and error rate <0.2%.

Darren: Watching SLOs and alerts. Will post immediately if thresholds approach. Ready to trigger rollback if needed.

Alice: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes and ping customers post-cutover.
